name: Crucible Industries Barrage-9 'Hornet'
description:
The Crucible Industries Barrage-9 is a fully automatic machine pistol chambered in 9x19mm, fed from a helical magazine holding fifty rounds. The weapon features a forward pistol grip, a muzzle compensator, and a cyclic rate of 1,100 rounds per minute that empties the magazine in under three seconds of continuous fire.

The Hornet is not subtle. It is a volume-of-fire weapon designed for situations where suppression and area denial matter more than precision. The helical magazine gives it ammunition capacity that rivals some submachine guns, and the compensator keeps the muzzle from climbing uncontrollably during full-auto fire — though 'controllable' is a generous description. In practice, operators fire in short bursts and accept that rounds will disperse across a roughly human-sized area at ten meters.

Crucible Industries sells the Barrage-9 exclusively to corponation military contracts and licensed heavy-security firms. It is one of the few pistol-class weapons that carries automatic-weapons-grade licensing requirements. On the black market, the Hornet commands premium prices and confers immediate credibility — or terror, depending on perspective.
specifications:
caliber: 9x19mm
effective_range: 25 meters (burst), 10 meters (full auto)
rate_of_fire: Full automatic, 1100 RPM
magazine_capacity: 50 rounds (helical)
weight: 1.4 kg (loaded)
tactical_use: A volume-of-fire weapon for close-quarters suppression and area denial. The high cyclic rate and large magazine capacity allow sustained suppressive fire from a pistol-sized platform. Not a precision weapon — effectiveness relies on volume rather than accuracy. Best employed in defensive positions or ambush scenarios where the operator can brace against something solid.
cultural_context: The Hornet is a weapon of excess. Carrying one says you expect — or want — the kind of trouble that requires fifty rounds in three seconds. In criminal circles, it's a power statement. In professional circles, it's an acknowledgment that sometimes the plan involves making a lot of noise and hoping quantity has a quality all its own.
story_hooks: A Hornet is used in a brazen attack on a corponation convoy in broad daylight — the fifty-round magazine is emptied in one burst, and every round hits the same vehicle with suspicious precision. Someone has modified the weapon with a targeting system it was never designed to carry.
Crucible Industries discovers that someone has reverse-engineered the helical magazine design and is producing unlicensed copies that fit other weapons platforms.

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact, aggressive machine pistol with a purposeful military aesthetic. The forward grip extends below the trigger guard like a skeletal hand, while the muzzle compensator adds brutal geometry to the front. The helical magazine creates an unusual, almost organic bulge that dominates the weapon's visual mass despite the pistol's overall small footprint.
physical_description.dimensions: Length: 22cm, Width: 5cm (with forward grip), Height: 12cm (including magazine), Barrel length: 10cm
physical_description.weight_description: Hefty and front-heavy when loaded, despite being technically 'light' for a 1.4kg platform. The helical magazine shifts the balance forward, demanding a solid grip and deliberate handling.
physical_description.primary_material: Hardened steel slide and frame with reinforced polymer lower receiver — standard Crucible Industries military-grade construction
physical_description.finish: Matte black anodized steel with brushed polymer accents. The forward grip shows intentional grip texture marks from thousands of gloved hands. Muzzle compensator has a dull grey parkerized finish.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary matte black with gunmetal grey muzzle compensator, subtle burnt-orange accent lines along the frame edges (Crucible Industries house color)
physical_description.grip_texture: Forward grip wrapped in aggressive diamond-pattern rubberized polymer; rear grip features textured ridges for gloved manipulation. Feels engineered for function, not comfort.
distinctive_features: Multi-port muzzle compensator with four angled vents creating a distinctive crown profile
Helical magazine with visible spiral ridges creating a distinctive cylindrical bulge
Tactical-grade Picatinny rail on top of slide for optics or targeting systems
Forward pistol grip positioned aggressively low for recoil management
Ambidextrous safety levers, worn from constant training manipulation
Small pressure-relief vents near the action from sustained rapid-fire heat cycling
Wear marks on the chamber area indicating consistent heavy use
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CRUCIBLE INDUSTRIES stamped in serif font on the left slide, above the ejection port. Serial plate mounted on right side of frame. Small Crucible diamond logo (◇) etched above the trigger guard.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained but battle-worn. Field operators keep the weapon clean and lubricated, but scuff marks, minor dings, and heat discoloration around the compensator are inevitable. This is a working gun, not a showpiece.
